purpose: Develop a fail-closed calibration certificate that rejects unreliable cross-dataset sufficiency-head reuse before evaluation or deployment, without changing the transferred head or conformal threshold.

development_boundary.reason: The admission guard is proposed after the leave-one-dataset-out transfer audit failed its adoption checks.
development_boundary.method_change: Admission-only; transferred scores, thresholds and declarations remain unchanged.

calibration_certificate.decision_unit: One target dataset and one pre-registered split version.

retrospective_evaluation.safe_certificate_definition: Certified repeat has evaluation incomplete-case-family false-complete rate at or below alpha=0.10.
retrospective_evaluation.useful_certificate_definition: Certified repeat has evaluation complete declaration recall at or above 0.10.

execution_policy.if_all_checks_pass: Freeze the admission guard before validating it on any new untouched dataset.
execution_policy.if_any_check_fails: Retain the negative result; require a target-fitted head and do not use new data to tune this guard cycle.

theoretical_scope.finite_sample_statement: The certificate does not strengthen the conformal guarantee; it only rejects some already calibrated transferred heads.
theoretical_scope.calibration_reuse_warning: Calibration recall and AUC are descriptive admission signals on the same calibration split used for the threshold, not independent performance estimates.

gate_policy: This post-hoc guard development cannot change Gate 2 from NO-GO/SHADOW or authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
